metrics.name: Total Transactions
metrics.definition: Count of transaction rows including duplicates and defective rows.

metrics.name: Processed Transactions
metrics.definition: Count of rows with status Completed.

metrics.name: Open Backlog
metrics.definition: Count of rows whose status is not Completed, including unknown statuses.

metrics.name: Completeness Rate
metrics.definition: Present mandatory observations / (6 × transaction rows).

metrics.name: Validity Rate
metrics.definition: Rows passing enabled Validity and Referential Integrity rules / transaction rows.

metrics.name: Duplicate Rate
metrics.definition: Duplicate IDs beyond the first nonblank occurrence / transaction rows.

metrics.name: Exception Rate
metrics.definition: Distinct transaction rows with persisted exceptions, including resolved history / transaction rows.

metrics.name: Overall Data Quality Score
metrics.definition: Configured weighted sum of completeness, validity, consistency, and timeliness rates; project methodology.

metrics.name: Average Processing TAT
metrics.definition: Mean nonnegative valid duration for Completed rows.

metrics.name: Median Processing TAT
metrics.definition: Median nonnegative valid duration for Completed rows.

metrics.name: SLA Compliance
metrics.definition: Completed rows with valid nonnegative duration ≤ configured SLA / eligible completed rows.

metrics.name: Rework Rate
metrics.definition: Completed rows with rework true / Completed rows.

metrics.name: Open Exceptions
metrics.definition: Exceptions with status other than Resolved or Closed.

metrics.name: Critical Exceptions
metrics.definition: Critical unresolved exceptions.

metrics.name: Exception Aging
metrics.definition: Unresolved exceptions grouped by elapsed days since detection at simulation as-of.

metrics.name: Average Resolution Time
metrics.definition: Mean valid nonnegative hours from detection to resolution for Resolved/Closed exceptions.

metrics.name: Open Actions
metrics.definition: Actions other than Completed or Cancelled.

metrics.name: Overdue Actions
metrics.definition: Open actions with valid due timestamp earlier than simulation as-of.

metrics.name: Action Completion Rate
metrics.definition: Completed actions / all actions, including cancelled actions.

metrics.name: Open Risks
metrics.definition: Risks whose status is not Closed.

metrics.name: High/Critical Risk Count
metrics.definition: Open risks with probability × impact ≥ configured high-risk threshold.

metrics.name: Risk Exposure
metrics.definition: Sum of probability × impact over open risks; ordinal score, not monetary exposure.
